svg.title: ADMS on AWS Outposts - reconstruction of the AWS reference
svg.desc: Two physically isolated data centers have separate Outposts racks homed to different Availability Zones. Local gateways connect OT and field devices; service links connect each rack to its home Region. Regional DERMS and analytics are separate from on-premises ADMS.
